FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 338
Committee: Veterans, Military Affairs, and Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Public Safety
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/10/2026
Senate Bill 338 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama
Board of Examiners in Counseling to adopt rules and establish additional procedures and
processes for criminal history background checks for initial applications for licensees.
